nodes.label: desktop memory - the desktop's Neo4j data location and sibling DBs

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the desktop machine's memory file - the live directory sits on the other machine and is not reachable from here, so this copy is what there is to review. Listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 6. The desktop's Neo4j Desktop 2 instance dbms-06f669f3-a00f-4170-9cad-ffb65fb1c612 has its data directory relocated to A:\Coding\neo4j\data\ via server.directories.data in neo4j.conf, while conf, binaries and logs still live in the default location; the subdirectory settings for transactions, dumps, cluster-state and scripts default to subdirs of data, so they follow automatically. The user explicitly does not want graph data on C:, so any SHOW SETTINGS or data-path question involves A:\. Sibling DBs and backup state as of 2026-05-25: herb-eval is the canonical artefact; herb-eval-backup is a queryable byte-identical clone of herb-eval taken before any tag-cleanup work, and is what to query for the before state in any before-versus-after comparison; A:\Coding\neo4j\backups\herb-eval.dump is the portable recovery artifact at 528 MB compressed, loadable into any database name with neo4j-admin database load, which requires a <target>.dump filename so the dump is renamed or copied first; and the other DBs in the instance are bonnier, lab4, herb (contaminated - do not query), neo4j (default, empty) and system
